name: recoil_app_play_state_on_resume
description: RecoilApp_PlayState::OnResume restarts CD audio for the current mission only when CD audio is enabled.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x42f8a0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same CD-audio gate and track calculation.

The dependency frontier for 0x42f8a0 has no visible source blockers; zSnd::GetCDAudioOption, HudSensorTracker::GetMissionId, zSndCd::GetTrackCount, and zSndCd::PlayTrackWithMode are accepted functional dependencies.
The native smoke sets the CD-audio option to disabled, calls OnResume, and verifies the function leaves CD state untouched.
